title: Bibliopolis topic tree
description: The topics of a collection as a forest: every node names its parent. What a schema cannot say (an id used once, a parent that exists, no cycle, at most 64 levels) the program checks; see docs/format.md.

id.description: Unique in the tree; no control characters.

label.description: The name shown for the road.

parent.description: The id of the parent node, or null for a root.
